content:
Signing up, and creating an account is absolutely free on Homaale, you just need to be over the age of 16. 
Head to Homaale.com and  click on sign up. You can sign up using your email address, facebook, or with your google account. We recommend you use your primary email address to not miss any important updates.

title: What are Homaale points ?
content: Homaale points are the reward points you get for using Homaale for numerous activities, or making transactions on Homaale. You can use avail reward points. The more you use Homaale, the more points you accumulate. These points can be availed for gifts provided by Homaale, or can be deducted during  your Homaale payments, subjected to terms and conditions.

title: What types of tasks are available on Homaale ?
content: From simple to complicated tasks, Homaale can help you complete your home cleaning, handyman jobs, admin work, photography, graphic design or even build a website.It's free to post a task, so just describe a task you’d like to get done, set a budget and you’ll start to receive offers from Taskers.

title: Who is a tasker ?
content: A Tasker is a person who can complete tasks for other people within the Homaale platform. They are contractors who hold member accounts, just as Merchants on the platform do.

title: Who is a Merchant ?
content: A Merchant is a person who's looking to get tasks completed, whether it's in person or online. A Merchant can either browse through the listings to book a tasker or they can post and assign a tasker to complete their task.

title: How many categories of tasks can one get done, or do via Homaale ?
content:
Our category listing is constantly updated, and increasing depending on the demand and feedback we receive from our customers. For now, our core categories are : 

Beauty and Makeup
Appliances Repair and Installation
Gardening
Food Genie
Home Repair, ,Maintenance, and Renovation
Milkman
Laundry
Babysitting
Newspaper Delivery
Hospitals/Healthcare
Accounting
Web Design and Development
Event  Management

title: My category is not listed, what can I do  ?
content: If your desired category is not listed on Homaale at the moment, it might be because we are still working on it to provide you a smooth service. However, you can always reach us out with the suggestion on the same.

title: I am a Merchant, and I provide a lot of other services apart from the ones listed above, what do I do ?
content: Please reach out to us, and your desired sub category shall be  added

title: What is KYC?
content: KYC (Know your Customer) is a process to ensure that every member  of Homaale is real.

title: Who needs to complete KYC?
content: Every Homaale member needs to complete their KYC to become a verified member.

title: Why does my account show “Unverified”?
content: This is because your KYC and profile details are incomplete. To use the services of Homaale, you must be a verified member.

title: How to submit KYC?
content: To submit your KYC, go to your profile and click on Account Settings. You will find “Complete your KYC” button. Open the KYC page, fill up all the information and upload your documents and submit.

title: Is KYC verification free of cost?
content: Yes, KYC verification is free of cost.

title: My KYC was not accepted. What shall I do now?
content: You can view the reasons why your KYC was not accepted. Make the necessary corrections and resend it for verification again.
